1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, __wherein said diodes are mounted within recessed cavities on said columnar body__.

2. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __and said diodes are positioned within said recessed cavities__.

3. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes, __wherein said optic element is integrally formed with said columnar body__.

4. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material __and is bonded to said columnar body__.

5. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body __and are recessed within the body surface__.

6. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __and extend radially outward from said body at angles between 30 and 60 degrees__.

7. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section __and has a non-uniform wall thickness__.

8. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body __within a recessed mounting pocket__.

9. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body __and is integrally formed therewith__.

10. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __and is mounted within a dedicated recessed cavity distinct from adjacent diode cavities__.

11. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK __and said material is a composite comprising copper or aluminum particles in a polymer matrix__.

12. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 including a single optic element disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode, __wherein each optic element is separately molded and attached to said columnar body__.

13. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base __and includes a thermal interface material between said base and said columnar body__.

14. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and is thermally coupled to said columnar body via a thermally conductive adhesive__.

15. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body __and includes a refractive index greater than 1.5__.

16. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body __within a recessed mounting cavity__, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, __wherein said diodes are positioned within recessed cavities rather than on the outer surface__, said lamp having a general A19 outline.

17. (Currently Amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, __forming recessed cavities on said body__, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body within said recessed cavities and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK __and comprises aluminum alloy 2014__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins __formed during the extrusion process__.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls __and uniform wall thickness except at said recessed cavities__.
